name: Balsero Kitty Litter Lab
summary: One of the Kitty Litter drug labs Tyrone asks you to destroy, in Balsero, Vice City; its garage keypad takes 1999.
body: PowerPyx and GTABase put one of Balsero's three labs in a garage in the building in the middle of the search area, where the objective marker is. Its wall keypad takes the code 1999, shown on a nearby billboard, and the lab pays $2,500. PowerPyx adds a receipt on the counter in the back left corner.
Push Square places it between NW 16th St and NW 17th St in Balsero, in a small garage unit at the north-west corner of NW 12th Ave with purple chemicals outside and a chimney on the roof.
Push Square says a few criminals loiter nearby and that shooting the propane tank inside destroys the lab.
PowerPyx, in the app, counts three labs in Balsero; this is the one on Push Square's list.
Push Square lists it among the labs for Tyrone's Take Out Kitty Litter job, tracked under Robberies in the pause menu.

The other two Balsero labs, per PowerPyx and GTABase: a garage on the north edge of the area with about three armed guards ($2,000), and the second trailer from the south, with a guard and a Spin On This van outside ($2,500). Neither needs a code.

facts.safe_code: 1999 (garage keypad; the code is on a nearby billboard)

name: Salton Kitty Litter Lab
summary: One of the Kitty Litter drug labs Tyrone asks you to destroy, in Salton, Vice City.
body: Push Square places it at the map marker on SW 7th Ave in Salton, in an area with few buildings.
Push Square says to climb a dumpster at the back and go in through an open window, deal with two criminals, then carry the propane tank from the kitchen to the equipment and shoot it.
Push Square lists it among the labs for Tyrone's Take Out Kitty Litter job, tracked under Robberies in the pause menu.
PC Gamer and GTABase say the Salton labs have no safe or keypad: you get in through a window or over a fence.

name: Crosstown Kitty Litter Lab
summary: One of the Kitty Litter drug labs Tyrone asks you to destroy, in Crosstown, Vice City.
body: Push Square places it in a block of flats on NE 10th St in Crosstown, with piping and smoke on the left side of the building.

Push Square says the lab is up the stairs on the second floor behind the door with chemicals outside, that a note sits on the kitchen counter, and that the kitchen propane tank or explosives destroy it.
PowerPyx, in the app, counts three labs in Crosstown; this is the one on Push Square's list.
Push Square lists it among the labs for Tyrone's Take Out Kitty Litter job, tracked under Robberies in the pause menu.
PC Gamer and GTABase say the Crosstown labs have no safe or keypad: you break in. Only the Balsero lab has a coded door (1999).

name: Rockridge Kitty Litter Lab
summary: One of the Kitty Litter drug labs Tyrone asks you to destroy, in Rockridge, Vice City.
body: Push Square places it in a small set of apartments on Santiago Ave in Rockridge, just west of Bump & Grind Coffee; Apartment 5, on the left, has piping and lab equipment outside.
Push Square says to break in, deal with the person inside and destroy the equipment with gas or explosives before getting away.
Push Square lists it among the labs for Tyrone's Take Out Kitty Litter job, tracked under Robberies in the pause menu.
PC Gamer and GTABase say the Rockridge labs have no safe or keypad: you break in.

name: Little Cuba Kitty Litter Lab
summary: One of the Kitty Litter drug labs Tyrone asks you to destroy, in Little Cuba, Vice City.
body: Push Square places it between NW 3rd Ave and I-97 in Little Cuba, with discarded Kitty Litter materials near the parking spaces.
Push Square says the door to use has a pipe coming out of the window, and that the kitchen propane tank or explosives destroy the lab once the person inside is dealt with.
Push Square lists it among the labs for Tyrone's Take Out Kitty Litter job, tracked under Robberies in the pause menu.
PC Gamer and GTABase say the Little Cuba lab has no safe or keypad: force the door or use the Snap Gun.

facts.location: Little Cuba, Vice City, Vice-Dale County
